name: Alexander Net
headline: Strategy & Operations Director | Commercial & GTM Strategy | Business Performance & Transformation
about:
Director-level Strategy & Operations leader with 15+ years of experience across financial services, technology, and FMCG industries, and enterprise SaaS. Proven track record driving go-to-market strategy, cross-functional operations, and business transformation across EMEA and international markets.

I operate at the intersection of strategy, commercial performance, and execution - translating high-level strategic priorities into operating cadence, KPI frameworks, and measurable business outcomes. My work spans corporate strategy, GTM optimisation, and operational delivery, often partnering directly with C-suite and regional leadership.

Key areas of focus include:
• Strategy & Operations leadership (planning, execution, operating models)
• Commercial growth and go-to-market (pipeline, win rate, efficiency)
• Business performance management (KPIs, operating cadence, execution tracking)
• Cross-functional transformation across Sales, Product, Operations and Finance

Experience includes:
• Leading cross-functional teams across multiple markets and functions
• Operating as trusted advisor to CEOs, MDs, Board, and senior leadership teams
• Delivering strategy and transformation programmes across Europe

I’m particularly interested in roles focused on strategy & operations, commercial strategy, and business performance in technology, financial services, and high-growth organisations.

Open to connecting on opportunities, market insights, and strategy & operations challenges.
